c-58ae23a690dc672c.texto: Cracknels (nikkuddim) were some sort of thin hard biscuit carried by the common people on their journeys. Their name (from nakad, to mark with points) may indicate thin punctured biscuits, or those which will easily crumble.

h-ce202a5b390a9bc1.texto: De Salomón al reino dividido, hasta cerca del reinado de Ocozías de Israel. Sin introducción propia de JFB en el repositorio; Poole sí la tiene.
